name: propped-fire-door
description: Fire exit door held open with a wedge; confidences out of range are clamped and one finding lacks a valid control.

candidateControls.title: Controlled entry points
candidateControls.objective: Entry points are closed and secured when not in use and are not propped open.

candidateControls.title: Exterior lock hardware grade
candidateControls.objective: Exterior and sensitive doors and enclosures use locking hardware that is engaged and of suitable grade.

condition.summary: Exit door held open with a rubber wedge.

deficiencies.description: Door propped open with a wedge, defeating closure and latching.

draftFindings.title: Exit door propped open
draftFindings.description: A rubber wedge holds the exit door open.
draftFindings.recommendation: Remove the wedge, alarm the door for held-open events, and brief staff.

draftFindings.title: Fire code concern
draftFindings.description: Propped fire doors may violate fire code.
